content.short: Portal provides an embedded MPC wallet SDK and security tools for developers and enterprises.
content.description: Portal offers a mobile-native MPC SDK and security tooling that lets developers and enterprises build web3 wallet experiences for users, with built-in recoverability so wallets aren’t lost and seed phrases aren’t required. The platform supports easy wallet integration across protocols, games, and other use cases, enabling customers to extend functionality and security features within their wallets. By combining multi-party computation with robust key management, Portal helps teams ship trusted, user-friendly wallet solutions.
content.meta: Portal offers embedded MPC wallet SDKs and security tooling for developers. Discover Portal and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
